recent.text: Rick Carlisle postgame: "I think the first half we played very solidly. We were tied together and then in the second half, we had some struggles." Asked by @TonyREast about the center minutes, Carlisle praised Jay Huff's shooting, ability to stretch the floor and rim protection

recent.text: 76ers beat the Pacers for the second time this season, 131-124. Siakam scored 23 of his 31pts in the second half while Zubac was only played 5mins during that stretch. James had 15 & 11a, Brown scored 31 and Maxey added 27. Next: Wed. v HOU
recent.author: Scott Agness

recent.text: 76ers take it 131-124, which I have to say is closer than I thought this would be with the Pacers missing Nembhard as well as Haliburton. Just a little too much Philly firepower there.

recent.text: Pacers have went away from Zubac for a while. Now more than a quarter of game action. Jay Huff has played 12 straight minutes. They're within seven, so this has a long way to go. But 76ers are in control.

recent.text: Pacers down 58-57 at the break. Pacers 23 of 46 from the floor, 3 of 16 from 3, 8 of 10 at the line, 1.10 per possession. Sixers 22 of 45, 9 of 20, 5 of 6, 1.12 per possession. Quenton Jackson 11 points. Jaylen Brown 20, Tyrese Maxey 15.
recent.author: Dustin Dopirak

recent.text: Nesmith and James each with hard falls on the same sequence at the end of the half. James mades two FTs to give the 76ers a 58-57 lead. Jaylen Brown leading all with 20pts, Maxey with 15. QJackson has 11. Pacers 3/16 from range (0/8 in 2Q), 76ers 9/20. That's been big.

recent.text: Quenton Jackson has put together a really good, smart game today. 9pts, 2rebs, 3asts in 11 minutes & starting. He's been smooth, patient, under control, making the right reads — and attacking when there's a gap.

recent.text: Slawson and McConnell — two of the hardest-playing Pacers — helped them to a 35-29 lead after 1 in Philly. Slawson had one sequence where he blocked a shot at one end, and got a rebound put-back at the other — racing in from the 3pt line untouched. Pacers shot 62%, but 5TOs
